sources.title: THE FROZEN THRONE: Queen of the Freljord

passive.name: Frost Shot
passive.text: Ashe's attacks slow their target, causing her to deal increased damage to these targets.Ashe's critical strikes deal no bonus damage but apply an empowered slow to the target.

spells.name: Ranger's Focus
spells.text: Ashe builds up Focus by attacking. At maximum Focus, Ashe can cast Ranger's Focus to consume all stacks of Focus, temporarily increasing her Attack Speed and transforming her basic attack into a powerful flurry attack for the duration.

spells.name: Volley
spells.text: Ashe fires arrows in a cone for increased damage. Also applies Frost Shot.

spells.name: Hawkshot
spells.text: Ashe sends her Hawk Spirit on a scouting mission anywhere on the map.

spells.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
spells.text: Ashe fires a missile of ice in a straight line. If the arrow collides with an enemy Champion, it deals damage and stuns the Champion, stunning for longer the farther arrow has traveled. In addition, surrounding enemy units take damage and are slowed.

damage.value: Ashe deals sustained damage through basic attacks.

archetype.value: Ashe is a ranged archer who kites while dealing damage with volleys of arrows.

axis.value: Ashe can play for constant poke or sustained damage from a safe position.

winCondition.value: Ashe wins fights by controlling enemies and delivering sustained damage from safety.

spikes.why: Ashe’s Frostbite Ballista build scales its damage through critical strikes.
Ashe gains stronger Frost Shot slows and more follow-up basic attack damage.

mistakes.value: Ashe becomes vulnerable when poor positioning exposes her immobility and low durability.
